sources.title: Product Hunt Launch Guide
supports: makers may hunt their own products
do not ask directly for upvotes
ask visitors to engage and comment

sources.title: Prepare for your Product Hunt launch
supports: 12:01 a.m. Pacific is a rule of thumb
schedule up to one month ahead

sources.title: How do I share my post?
Product Hunt Featuring Guidelines
supports: usefulness and high craft influence featuring

sources.title: How to schedule a post
supports: draft and scheduled states are distinct

conclusions: NodeRoom should be self-hunted by a maker using a personal account.
The launch should ask people to visit, try, comment, and give feedback, never to upvote.
The owner should choose a staffed time; 12:01 a.m. Pacific is optional guidance, not a success hack.
Do not schedule while noderoom.live lacks the approved production user journey and independent taste pass.
